title: Savings & Copay Assistance Programs: Days Supply and the Manufacturer Copay Card Reimbursement Limit
content:
The days supply of the fill decides how the Manufacturer Copay Card reimbursement limit per 28 days of supply of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs covers the fill: a fill of **84 days or more** gets **three times** the limit, a fill of **56 to 83 days** gets **twice** the limit, and a shorter fill gets the limit **once**.

The days supply is the days supply dispensed that the Prescriptions fill ledger shows on the fill being reimbursed. The limit multiplied is the reimbursement limit per 28 days of supply as it stands with every amount added to it.

| Days supply dispensed | Limit on the fill |
|---|---|
| 55 or fewer | the limit per 28 days of supply, once |
| 56 to 83 | twice the limit per 28 days of supply |
| 84 or more | three times the limit per 28 days of supply |

**Hypothetical fills with a limit of $800.00 per 28 days of supply:** a 30-day fill $800.00; a 55-day fill $800.00; a 56-day fill $1600.00; an 84-day fill $2400.00.
